name: Full-bleed hero with animated line-by-line headline and live open/closed status
notes: Three one-word headline lines ('Climbed.' 'Cut.' 'Cleared.') each animate in on their own line — punchy rhythm pattern worth reusing for trades with a clear step-by-step process. Has a commented-out slot for swapping the still image for a looping background video once the client supplies footage. data-status/data-status-text hooks are for a live business-hours widget (JS not included, static fallback text shown as-is).
